use_VASP_FLAGS_slab_optimization: use the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure slab and adslab DFT optimization parameters
use_BULK_VASP_FLAGS_crystal_optimization: use the BULK_VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure bulk crystal structure optimization parameters
use_SOLVENT_BASE_FLAGS_solvent_simulatio: use the SOLVENT_BASE_FLAGS dictionary to configure solvent environment simulation parameters with dipole corrections
use_SOLVENT_BULK_VASP_FLAGS_combined: use the SOLVENT_BULK_VASP_FLAGS dictionary to configure combined solvent and bulk optimization parameters
use_RELAX_FLAGS_quick_relaxation: use the RELAX_FLAGS dictionary to configure a quick ionic relaxation with 5 steps
